# IE Static

> Static content repository for IE University's institutional pages, admissions materials, and program information.

IE Static hosts marketing collateral, institutional overviews, and administrative forms for IE University and its schools. The site serves as a central repository for program-specific content, admissions resources, and enrollment documentation across IE's academic divisions.

## Key Topics

- IE University
- IE Law School
- MIM Challenge
- Admissions
- Student Registration
- Legal Education
- Curriculum
- Enrollment
- European Economic Area (EEA)
- Admission Forms
- Contact Information
- Institutional Programs

## Academic Programs

- [IE Law School](https://static.ie.edu/marketing/law_school/Ruta_Law_2017.html): IE Law School institutional overview and legal education curriculum

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [IE University Student Registration Form](https://static.ie.edu/university/forms/eng.html): IE University student registration and admission form for EEA applicants
- [MIM Challenge](https://static.ie.edu/marketing/IE_Projects_Advertising_2016/MIM_Challenge.html): IE MIM Challenge admissions page with contact information
